# gravity_role_api (Resource)

Configuration of the API role. Note that changing `port` or `listen_override` changes the endpoint this provider itself talks to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gravity_role_api" "api" {
  port             = 8008
  session_duration = "168h"

  oidc {
    client_id            = "gravity"
    client_secret        = var.oidc_client_secret
    issuer               = "https://id.my-domain.com/"
    redirect_url         = "https://gravity.my-domain.com/auth/callback"
    scopes               = ["openid", "email", "profile"]
    token_username_field = "preferred_username"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cookie_secret` (String, Sensitive) Key used to sign session cookies. The server creates one when this is left unset; changing it invalidates every existing session. Generated.
- `listen_override` (String) Override the address the API listens on.
- `oidc` (Block List, Max: 1) OIDC provider used to authenticate to the web interface. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--oidc))
- `port` (Number) Defaults to `8008`.
- `session_duration` (String) How long a web session stays valid, as a Go duration (e.g. `168h`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--oidc"></a>
### Nested Schema for `oidc`

Optional:

- `client_id` (String)
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive)
- `issuer` (String)
- `redirect_url` (String)
- `scopes` (List of String)
- `token_username_field` (String) Claim in the ID token to take the username from.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Role configurations are singletons, identified by the role name
terraform import gravity_role_api.api 'api'
```
